_fixture_provenance.why_team_1678_and_not_254: This fixture previously recorded team 254 at 2024casj. That team-event does not exist and never did: team 254's 2024 events were 2024cabe, 2024cada, 2024new and 2024cmptx (verified via GET /v3/team_events?team=254&year=2024), and 254 is absent from the 42-team 2024casj roster. Statbotics answers a nonexistent team-event with HTTP 500 rather than 404, which is why GET /v3/team_event/254/2024casj still fails even now that their API is healthy - that particular 500 was never an outage. Team 1678 (Citrus Circuits) did attend 2024casj, so it is recorded here; the event key, and therefore this file's name and every reference to it, is unchanged.

The shape inferred from Statbotics's published response serializer in 2026-07-25 was correct.
